scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy:prod: wrangler deploy -c wrangler.production.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.production.jsonc

PAD_DOMAIN.description: Leave empty to serve pages under `/p/<id>`. Set it to your domain (for example `pads.example.com`) once that domain and `*.pads.example.com` point to this Worker, so each page gets its own subdomain.

PUBLISH_LIMIT.description: New pages one client address may publish per `PUBLISH_WINDOW_SECONDS`.

PAD_TTL_DAYS.description: Days a page lives after its last update, unless the agent asks for longer (up to `PAD_MAX_TTL_DAYS`).

REPORT_HIDE_THRESHOLD.description: Reports from different readers before a page is hidden for review.

CDN_ALLOWLIST.description: Space-separated hosts pages may load scripts and styles from.
